subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component clicks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields are public versus plugin-only?
rationale: This changes public agent inbound context and exposes Discord identifiers/callback data, so maintainers need to choose schema, compatibility shape, and trust boundary before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a documented metadata envelope with originating message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields only in plugin interactive handlers and document plugin callbacks as the supported path for stateful Discord component workflows.

options.title: Start With Minimal IDs
options.body: Expose only clicker and originating message ids first, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a documented metadata envelope with originating message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The Discord Components v2 feature history makes this the clearest Discord-owner routing candidate for the public callback contract choice.
